description:
A Java Maven project has been loaded at ~/IdeaProjects/refactor-demo/. The Calculator.java file contains code with poor naming conventions and duplicated code. Use IntelliJ IDEA's refactoring tools to improve the code quality:

1. Rename the method 'calc' to 'calculate'
2. Rename the parameters: 'x' to 'firstOperand', 'y' to 'secondOperand', 'o' to 'operation'
3. Extract the repeated logging code (the 3 println statements in each branch) into a helper method named 'logOperation'

The project should compile successfully after refactoring.
